error.message: [{{statusCode}}] MeetStream could not complete this request. Check the module inputs and service status.

400.message: [400] Check the meeting URL, options, and scheduled join time. Scheduled times must be in the future.

401.message: [401] Update the API key in your MeetStream connection.

403.message: [403] Check your MeetStream API key, account permissions, credits, and resource ownership. This can be a resource or credit restriction even when the connection is valid.

404.message: [404] The resource was not found or the artifact is not ready. Verify the ID and wait for the corresponding processed event.

409.message: [409] The deduplication key belongs to a different meeting, or transcription was not enabled. Check the bot configuration.

429.message: [429] MeetStream is throttling requests or has no available signed-in login. Retry-After: {{ifempty(get(headers, 'retry-after'), 'not supplied')}}. Use a bounded retry policy and check signed-in bot capacity.

507.message: [507] MeetStream returned an Idempotency-Key replay. Do not retry it. Use Create a Bot with a Deduplication Key for native Make replay handling.
